description: Separate structural alignment of the two SucD-like halves of AllF onto SucD, with residue-level mapping of the catalytic His and CoA site
code:
import requests, numpy as np, pandas as pd
from scipy.spatial import cKDTree
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
AA3={'ALA':'A','ARG':'R','ASN':'N','ASP':'D','CYS':'C','GLN':'Q','GLU':'E','GLY':'G','HIS':'H','ILE':'I',
'LEU':'L','LYS':'K','MET':'M','MSE':'M','PHE':'F','PRO':'P','SER':'S','THR':'T','TRP':'W','TYR':'Y','VAL':'V'}
def parse(txt,ch):
    ca={};aa={};sq={}
    for l in txt.splitlines():
        if l.startswith(("ATOM","HETATM")) and len(l)>54 and l[21]==ch:
            rn=l[17:20].strip()
            if rn not in AA3 or l[16] not in (' ','A'): continue
            ri=int(l[22:26]);an=l[12:16].strip()
            x=np.array([float(l[30:38]),float(l[38:46]),float(l[46:54])])
            aa.setdefault(ri,{})[an]=x; sq[ri]=AA3[rn]
            if an=='CA': ca[ri]=x
    return ca,aa,sq
def het(txt,ch,rn):
    return np.array([[float(l[30:38]),float(l[38:46]),float(l[46:54])]
        for l in txt.splitlines() if l.startswith("HETATM") and l[21]==ch and l[17:20].strip()==rn and len(l)>54])
t3=requests.get("https://files.rcsb.org/download/3DMY.pdb",timeout=120).text
t1=requests.get("https://files.rcsb.org/download/1JKJ.pdb",timeout=120).text
caF,atF,seqF=parse(t3,"A"); caD,atD,seqD=parse(t1,"A")
coa=het(t1,"A","COA"); po4=het(t1,"A","PO4")
rD=sorted(caD); Y=np.array([caD[i] for i in rD]); nD=len(rD)
def kabsch(P,Q):
    pc,qc=P.mean(0),Q.mean(0);H=(P-pc).T@(Q-qc);U,S,Vt=np.linalg.svd(H)
    return Vt.T@np.diag([1,1,np.sign(np.linalg.det(Vt.T@U.T))])@U.T, qc-(Vt.T@np.diag([1,1,np.sign(np.linalg.det(Vt.T@U.T))])@U.T)@pc
def app(R,t,P): return (R@P.T).T+t
def dp(S):
    n,m=S.shape; V=np.zeros((n+1,m+1)); PT=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),np.int8)
    for i in range(1,n+1):
        diag=V[i-1,:-1]+S[i-1]; up=V[i-1,1:]
        src=np.where(diag>=up,0,1).astype(np.int8); tmp=np.maximum(diag,up)
        acc=np.maximum.accumulate(tmp); PT[i,1:]=np.where(acc>tmp,2,src); V[i,1:]=acc
    i,j=n,m;out=[]
    while i>0 and j>0:
        p=PT[i,j]
        if p==0: out.append((i-1,j-1)); i-=1;j-=1
        elif p==1: i-=1
        else: j-=1
    return out[::-1]

def align(rFsub):
    X=np.array([caF[i] for i in rFsub]); nF=len(rFsub)
    d0=max(1.24*(min(nF,nD)-15)**(1/3)-1.8,0.5)
    def refine(pairs,rounds):
        best=(-1,None,None,None)
        for _ in range(rounds):
            if len(pairs)<4: break
            R,t=kabsch(X[[a for a,b in pairs]],Y[[b for a,b in pairs]])
            Dm=np.linalg.norm(app(R,t,X)[:,None,:]-Y[None,:,:],axis=2)
            S=1.0/(1.0+(Dm/d0)**2); p2=dp(S); tm=sum(S[a,b] for a,b in p2)/nD
            if tm>best[0]:
                dd=np.array([Dm[a,b] for a,b in p2])
                best=(tm,p2,(R,t),[p for p,x in zip(p2,dd) if x<5.0])
            if p2==pairs: break
            pairs=p2
        return best
    b=(-1,None,None,None)
    for off in range(-nF+25,nD-25,10):
        pr=[(i,i+off) for i in range(nF) if 0<=i+off<nD]
        if len(pr)>=25:
            r=refine(pr,4)
            if r[0]>b[0]: b=r
    tm,pairs,_,core=refine(b[1],25)
    R,t=kabsch(X[[a for a,b in core]],Y[[b for a,b in core]])
    rmsd=float(np.sqrt(((app(R,t,X[[a for a,b in core]])-Y[[b for a,b in core]])**2).sum(1).mean()))
    return dict(tm=tm,pairs=pairs,core=core,R=R,t=t,rmsd=rmsd,rF=rFsub,X=X)

halves={"AllF N-half (101-331): Rossmann + SSF52210 #1":[r for r in sorted(caF) if 101<=r<=331],
        "AllF C-half (332-555): SSF52210 #2 + Rossmann":[r for r in sorted(caF) if 332<=r<=555],
        "AllF full (101-555)":sorted(caF)}
sites={246:"catalytic His247 (phospho-His)",16:"CoA Thr17 (Gly-rich loop)",42:"CoA Lys43",95:"CoA Ile96",158:"CoA Tyr159"}
summary=[]; detail=[]
for lab,sub in halves.items():
    A=align(sub)
    d2f={rD[b]:A['rF'][a] for a,b in A['pairs']}
    sid=sum(1 for a,b in A['core'] if seqF[A['rF'][a]]==seqD[rD[b]])
    FAt={ri:{an:app(A['R'],A['t'],v[None,:])[0] for an,v in atF[ri].items()} for ri in sub}
    allxyz=np.array([v for ri in FAt for v in FAt[ri].values()]); tree=cKDTree(allxyz)
    dmc,_=tree.query(coa)
    hit=[]
    for p,role in sorted(sites.items()):
        if p in d2f:
            q=d2f[p]; hit.append(f"{seqD[p]}{p+1}->{seqF[q]}{q}{'*' if seqD[p]==seqF[q] else ''}")
        else: hit.append(f"{seqD[p]}{p+1}->unaligned")
        detail.append(dict(half=lab.split(':')[0], SucD=f"{seqD[p]}{p+1}", role=role,
                           AllF=(f"{seqF[d2f[p]]}{d2f[p]}" if p in d2f else "unaligned"),
                           identical=(p in d2f and seqD[p]==seqF[d2f[p]])))
    summary.append(dict(region=lab, n_res=len(sub), TM=round(A['tm'],3), aligned=len(A['pairs']),
                        core5A=len(A['core']), rmsd=round(A['rmsd'],2),
                        core_identity_pct=round(100*sid/len(A['core']),1),
                        CoA_atoms_clash_2p5A=int((dmc<2.5).sum()), CoA_atoms_contact_4A=int((dmc<4).sum()),
                        His247=hit[0]))
sm=pd.DataFrame(summary)
print("=== Structural alignment of AllF domains onto E. coli SucD (1JKJ chain A) ===")
print(sm.to_string(index=False))
dt=pd.DataFrame(detail)
print("\n=== Residue-level mapping ===")
print(dt.to_string(index=False))
print("\nAllF catalytic-His equivalent conserved in ANY alignment:", bool(dt[(dt.SucD=='H247')&dt.identical].shape[0]))
print("Any SucD CoA-binding residue identity retained:", bool(dt[(dt.SucD!='H247')&dt.identical].shape[0]))

fig,ax=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(14,5))
a=ax[0]
x=np.arange(len(sm)); a.bar(x,sm.TM,color=["#2b6cb0","#2f855a","#718096"])
for i,v in enumerate(sm.TM): a.text(i,v+0.01,f"{v}\n{sm.core5A[i]} res\n{sm.rmsd[i]} A",ha="center",fontsize=9)
a.set_xticks(x); a.set_xticklabels(["N-half\n101-331","C-half\n332-555","full\n101-555"])
a.set_ylabel("TM-score vs SucD (normalised by SucD)"); a.set_ylim(0,0.85)
a.axhline(0.5,ls="--",c="#c53030"); a.annotate("0.5 = same fold",(2.2,0.52),fontsize=8,color="#c53030")
a.set_title("AllF is a tandem duplication of the SucD fold")
a=ax[1]
sub=dt[dt.half=="AllF full (101-555)"] if "AllF full (101-555)" in set(dt.half) else dt
lbl=[];val=[]
for h in dt.half.unique():
    d=dt[dt.half==h]
    val.append([1 if r.identical else 0 for r in d.itertuples()])
val=np.array(val)
im=a.imshow(val,cmap="Reds",vmin=0,vmax=1,aspect="auto")
a.set_yticks(range(len(dt.half.unique()))); a.set_yticklabels([h.split('(')[0] for h in dt.half.unique()],fontsize=9)
a.set_xticks(range(5)); a.set_xticklabels([f"{r.SucD}\n{r.role.split('(')[0][:14]}" for r in dt[dt.half==dt.half.unique()[0]].itertuples()],fontsize=8)
for i in range(val.shape[0]):
    for j in range(val.shape[1]):
        d=dt[dt.half==dt.half.unique()[i]].iloc[j]
        a.text(j,i,d.AllF,ha="center",va="center",fontsize=8,color="black")
a.set_title("SucD catalytic and CoA residues mapped into AllF\n(none retained; cell text = structurally equivalent AllF residue)")
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
